system.name: FlashMem
system.one_liner: a memory-streaming framework that reduces memory use and latency for large-scale and multi-DNN inference on mobile GPUs

components.name: Input Model
components.role: the DNN model parsed to identify each layer's structure

components.name: Profiler
components.role: parses the model and, via capacity-based predictions, estimates how much additional data each layer can load without significant slowdown

components.name: LC-OPG Solver
components.role: the CP-SAT solver that produces an overlap plan scheduling weight-loading tasks, unfusing large fused operators when global constraints (C0-C4) fail

components.name: XGBoost
components.role: learned model supplying capacity-based (memory/latency) predictions used by the solver's tuning

components.name: Kernel Info
components.role: kernel information fed back into the Profiler

components.name: Weights Reorg.
components.role: the weight-reorganization output of the Offline Stage passed to Online Execution

components.name: Overlap Plan
components.role: the schedule of weight-loading tasks produced by the LC-OPG Solver, passed to Online Execution

components.name: Pipeline Loading
components.role: loads weights in a pipelined manner during online execution

components.name: Preload & Transform
components.role: preloads and transforms weight data into texture layout

components.name: Texture Data
components.role: weight data laid out in 2.5D texture memory tiles

components.name: UM Data
components.role: data resident in unified memory during online execution

components.name: Kernel Rewriting
components.role: rewrites each GPU kernel to embed data-loading operations within its computation, per the overlap plan

components.name: Overlap Execution
components.role: interleaves arithmetic operations with continuous, vectorized data reads to maximize GPU utilization

content.key_idea: FlashMem splits into an offline stage that profiles a model and uses a CP-SAT (LC-OPG) solver, aided by an XGBoost capacity predictor, to produce a weight-loading overlap plan, and an online stage that streams weights into texture memory and rewrites kernels to interleave computation with data loading according to that plan.

summary: Figure 3 gives the overall system overview of FlashMem, a memory-streaming framework for large-scale and multi-DNN inference on mobile GPUs, built on the SmartMem execution framework. The diagram splits into a green Offline Stage and a blue Online Execution stage. Offline, an Input Model is parsed by a Profiler that uses capacity-based predictions (aided by an XGBoost model) to estimate how much extra data each layer can load without slowdown; a Weights Slicer prepares weight layers for the LC-OPG Solver, a CP-SAT solver that produces an Overlap Plan scheduling weight-loading tasks and, when global constraints fail, selectively unfuses large fused operators via its Tuning/Adaptive Fusion step, yielding a Weights Reorg. plan. Online, these outputs drive Pipeline Loading and Preload & Transform into Texture Data, while Kernel Rewriting embeds data-loading operations directly into each GPU kernel's computation per the overlap plan, enabling Dynamic Offloading and Overlap Execution that interleaves arithmetic with vectorized data reads.
summary_zh: 该图展示 FlashMem 系统总览，分为绿色离线阶段与蓝色在线执行阶段：离线阶段解析输入模型、用 XGBoost 辅助的容量预测切分权重，由 CP-SAT（LC-OPG）求解器生成重叠加载计划并在约束失败时拆分算子；在线阶段据此进行流水加载、纹理数据预处理，并将数据加载嵌入内核重写以实现重叠执行。
